name: model-advisor
description: Cog the robot weighs the prompt that starts your work and advises the lowest model and effort that will do it well: a gate holds the prompt until you switch, send anyway or keep it.

mode.description: gate: a prompt that fits another model or effort waits in the band above the prompt until you pick. hints: the prompt is sent at once and the band shows the advice for the next prompt.
mode.title: Mode

gateOn.description: Which advice holds the prompt in gate mode. both: every advice. down: only when a lower model or effort is enough (the other advice shows as a hint). up: only when the work needs more.
gateOn.title: Gate on

trigger.description: conversation: weigh the first prompt of each conversation (start, /clear, compaction) and when you ask. every: weigh every prompt typed while Claude is idle (one small model call per prompt).
trigger.title: When to advise

model.description: The model that weighs the prompt: an alias such as haiku, or a full model id.
model.title: Advisor model

ladder.description: The models Cog may advise, from the cheapest to the most capable, as /model takes them, separated by commas. Remove the ones your account cannot use.
ladder.title: Model ladder

effortTolerance.description: An effort that is at most this many levels from the advised one is left alone. 0 advises on every difference.
effortTolerance.title: Effort tolerance (levels)

minChars.description: Prompts shorter than this many characters are never weighed (no model call).
minChars.title: Minimum prompt length
